verdict.rationale: WorkOS publishes its own Auth0 migration guide and a WorkOS CLI migrations tool that exports users, organizations, memberships, roles and SSO handoff files for import through the AuthKit API. That covers the vendor-maintained guide and tooling part of the story. Nothing in the pack shows that password hashes are imported or that users avoid password resets, which is a core element of the story. Missing for 10: evidence of password hash import or a no-reset migration path, named guides for competitors beyond Auth0, independent or hands-on corroboration of the migration tooling.

support.subject: As a founder, I can follow vendor-maintained migration guides or tooling for moving off a competing auth provider without forcing password resets

citations.quote: The fastest way to export Auth0 data is with the WorkOS CLI migrations tool
This produces a migration package with users, organizations, memberships, roles, SSO handoff files, and warnings.
In this guide, we will walk through the steps to export, and then import your users, organizations, and enterprise SSO connections from Auth0.
The WorkOS AuthKit API allows you to migrate your existing user data from a variety of existing sources.
